brief:
Israeli officials convened a special security meeting to address kites launched by Palestinian children in Gaza, according to Middle East Eye. The officials warned they would treat the kites as a security threat and threatened military strikes and evacuations in response to their use.

The escalation marks a shift in how Israeli authorities are responding to the practice. Kites have become a recurring flashpoint in Gaza, where they have drawn Israeli military attention and prompted warnings from officials over recent months. The threatened response — including potential airstrikes and civilian evacuation orders — signals a hardening stance on the activity.

title: Israel warns of strikes over kites flown by Gaza children
